jobs.title: Intermediate Data Engineer
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Data Engineer at GitLab, you'll build, run, and maintain the pipelines and infrastructure that bring data from our enterprise applications, internal systems, and GitLab's software as a service (SaaS) platform into our data platform. Your work will power company reporting, data science, and artificial intelligence (AI) self-service.</p> <p>You'll own features end to end, from source integration to tested, monitored, documented data ready for use. You'll focus on keeping the platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient as data volumes and AI usage grow, and making governed data ready for AI tools, agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based access. This is an AI-first role: you'll use AI coding agents every day while maintaining high standards for code review and testing. You'll report to the Director, Data Platform.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build, extend, and maintain extract, load, transform (ELT) pipelines from enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Zuora, Zendesk, and Marketo, internal systems, and the GitLab SaaS platform. Integrate data through application programming interfaces (APIs) and event sources such as Snowplow.</li> <li>Manage and maintain the infrastructure behind the platform, including SaaS tools such as Snowflake, Fivetran, and Monte Carlo, and self-managed services such as Airflow and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Write maintainable, well-tested, performant Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) code that meets our internal standards, and review GitLab team members' merge requests.</li> <li>Own day-to-day platform operations: triage and resolve failed pipelines, infrastructure issues, and GitLab team member requests. Use monitoring, service-level agreements (SLAs), data contracts, query and warehouse tuning, and data quality checks to keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Governance, and business partners so data lands in the shape they need for downstream use.</li> <li>Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, GitLab Duo, or similar tools to speed up development, debugging, testing, and documentation without compromising review rigor.</li> <li>Apply role-based access control (RBAC) and masking policies to make governed data available to AI tools and agents. Handle data subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls, material nonpublic information (MNPI), and personal data safely.</li> <li>Ship medium-sized features independently in small, iterative merge requests, and document architecture and runbooks in the handbook.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You'll Bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Professional experience shipping production data pipelines in Python.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on SQL skills and experience with a cloud data warehouse; Snowflake is preferred.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with ELT or extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines at scale, including incremental loads, schema changes, backfills, and API ingestion.</li> <li>Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow, familiarity with dbt, and solid data modeling fundamentals, including Kimball dimensional modeling.</li> <li>Experience running and troubleshooting data infrastructure, with comfort using Git-based workflows, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and code review.</li> <li>Hands-on experience using AI coding tools in your daily work, with an understanding of where they help and where they fall short.</li> <li>Clear written communication, the ability to use GitLab, and comfort working asynchronously in a fully remote organization in line with GitLab's values.</li> <li>Preferred, not required: experience with Snowflake; Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Terraform; SaaS application APIs such as Salesforce, Zuora, or Zendesk; data observability tooling; or Snowflake administration.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Data Platform team within Enterprise Data is responsible for a scalable, reliable and secure data platform for data analytics at GitLab. That includes managing and maintaining the infrastructure we use, both SaaS and self-managed, and building and maintaining the data pipelines that bring data into it. We make data reliable, secure and ready for analytics, data science and AI tools. As more questions go straight to AI tools and agents, the platform underneath has to be more reliable, better governed and more cost-efficient than ever. We're fully remote and globally distributed, and work asynchronously through issues, merge requests and the handbook.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><p><strong>What is the role: </strong></p> <p>We’re always on the search for amazing people. People who have a deep passion for technology and are masters at their craft. We build highly sophisticated distributed systems, and we don’t take our technology lightly. At Elastic, you’ll have the opportunity to work in a vibrant young company next to some of the smartest and highly skilled technologists the industry has to offer. We’re looking for great team players, but we also promote independence and ownership. We’re hackers… The good kind. The kind that innovates and creates cutting edge products that eventually translates to a lot of happy, smiling faces.</p> <p>Elastic’s Support team is unlike any other on Earth: while we are spread across 12 time zones and 15 countries, we operate as a unit, as a family. We are massively distributed yet lovingly intimate. The service we deliver is caring, empathetic, and human yet ambitious, direct, and comprehensive. We don’t do it alone, as we are tightly integrated with our core developers in a way that is real, genuine, and never taken for granted. Our team is a dream for someone seeking honest, hard work and rewards. It is a nightmare for anyone afraid to ask questions or be questioned — always forward, never backward. We are not trying to change the world, we already have. We’re just waiting for everyone else to catch up. We have our good days and our not so good days, and we face them together, as a family. We listen. We solve. We guide. We get it. And we’re excited to bring on a new team member to love.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What You Will Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ensuring technical customer issues are serviced within our contractual SLA and managed to resolution</li> <li>Maintain strong relationships with our customers for the delivery of technical support</li> <li>Resolves customer problems via telephone, email, chat or remote access.</li> <li>Have a mindset of continuous improvement in terms of the efficiency of support processes and customer satisfaction</li> <li>Work across multicultural and geographically distributed teams</li> <li>Contribute to product documentation, customer knowledge base, and best practices guides</li> <li>Continuously improve processes and tools in collaboration with the team</li> <li>Provide weekend on-call support for the team rotation (8 hours during regular work hours)</li> <li>Develop subject matter expertise one key product feature</li> <li>Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. </li> <li>Take part in organizational projects, programs and/or business initiatives using demonstrated creativity lab environments to replicate customer issues.</li> <li>Communicate tactfully with customers: gather information, provide diagnostic and resolution steps, convey process and product guidance</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What You Bring Along<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ (7+ for C6) years of experience in technical support, system administration or related customer-facing role</li> <li>A technical background in systems administration, Network Engineering, Software Engineering, etc</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills in English</li> <li>A customer-oriented focus</li> <li>Good understanding of cloud-native and container-based technologies</li> <li>Cloud technologies such as AWS, GCP, Azure and frameworks such as Kubernetes and Docker</li> <li>Understand the Product Lifecycle and future direction for the supported products or product line</li> <li>Strong understanding of cloud-native and container-based distributed systems like Kubernetes</li> <li>Advanced level of hands-on generalist experience at: Java (e.g. JVMS & components), Operational Systems (e.g. Linux and Windows), Networks (e.g. LDAP, Load Balancers, Proxies, SSL);</li> <li>Experience with APIs and REST calls;</li> <li>Experience with web/application servers (e.g. Tomcat, Apache, IIS, NGINX, Jboss);</li> <li>Advanced troubleshooting skills in web technology systems (e.g. HTML, CSS, Javascript)</li> <li>Experience with SSO, SAML, Active Directory, etc;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of databases or search software technologies</li> <li>Experience with SaaS and/or Distributed systems</li> <li>You are a Team player; the ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a positive and adaptable approach</li> <li>Proven strong technical understanding of software products</li> <li>Collaboration with Developer teams on escalation issues</li> <li>Curiosity is key! You have already researched our products and possibly downloaded our stack to test it out </li> <li>Networking</li> <li>Server Administration</li> <li>Wireshark or comparable packet analysis tool</li> <li>Exposure to scripting (Shell, Python, etc.)</li> <li>Experience with support tools and platforms like Salesforce, Zendesk and JIRA.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An Overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Data Scientist at GitLab on the Enterprise Analytics team,  you’ll be a trusted analytical partner to Sales, Revenue Operations, and Finance, helping define how we measure go-to-market performance and where we invest to grow. This is a strategic and hands-on role. You’ll apply statistical, experimentation, and machine learning methods to forecast outcomes, explain what drives activation, conversion, expansion, and retention, and size opportunities. You’ll also support the company-level reporting and GTM performance views that executives use to run the business, covering consumption, ARR, and first orders.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Embed yourself with business teams to become a trusted partner supporting insight generation and strategic decision making across GTM.</li> <li>Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover behavioral trends, long-term patterns, and the key drivers and levers behind business performance, and communicate their impact clearly to non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Build and productionize machine learning models - such as propensity, product-qualified lead (PQL) scoring, churn, and expansion models - including training, validation, testing, and feature engineering, using MLOps practices and tooling (CI/CD for ML pipelines, model registries, automated retraining, and monitoring) to move work reliably from notebook to production</li> <li>Design, run, and evaluate growth experiments (A/B tests and quasi-experiments) on onboarding, pricing and packaging, and upgrade flows, and measure their impact on activation, conversion, and retention</li> <li>Build and operationalize agentic workflows for analysis, modeling, and pipeline automation, with evaluation and monitoring that keep agent-generated insights accurate, traceable, and trustworthy.</li> <li>Contribute to GitLab’s Semantic Layer enabling stakeholders and agents to self-serve metrics using trusts and tested sources.</li> <li>Write production-grade Python and SQL that meets internal standards for style, maintainability, and performance in a high-scale database environment; maintain and advocate for these standards through code review</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>3-5 years of professional experience in GTM analytics, data science, or a similar technical role</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear, measurable questions and communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience with experimentation and causal inference (A/B testing, power analysis, quasi-experimental methods) and with statistical and machine learning methods such as regression, classification, clustering, and survival analysis</li> <li>Deep, hands-on understanding of SQL in cloud data warehouses (like Snowflake SQL), including working with product usage and event data, and in business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Hex, or similar)</li> <li>Experience using Python for statistical modeling, machine learning, and production data science. With hands-on experience in pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Jupyter, and related libraries such as LightGBM and XGBoost</li> <li>Hands-on experience building agentic workflows with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, OpenCode, or similar), including connecting agents to the right context, tools, and platforms such as MLflow, and evaluating their output for accuracy and reliability.</li> <li>Experience working in a B2C company working with motions and metrics, including Consumption, CRR, ARR, and Churn & Contraction</li> <li>Self-motivated and self-managing, with strong organizational skills</li> <li>Ability to use GitLab and to thrive in a fully remote organization</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>The Enterprise Analytics team builds the trusted data products and insights behind GitLab’s Company wide sales, revenue, and finance reporting. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Industry Solutions
jobs.description: <p>MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/post/stack-overflow-research-most-wanted-database">#1 most wanted database</a>, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.</p> <p>To support this growth, we are expanding our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/post/transitioning-teacher-mongodbs-new-enterprise-modernization-team-meet-gabriela-preiss">Industry Solutions Team</a> (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.</p> <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.</p> <p>This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.</p> <p>We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.</p> <h3>What you’ll do at MongoDB</h3> <p>In this role, you will</p> <ul> <li>Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment</li> <li>Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions</li> <li>Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover</li> <li>Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments</li> <li>Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries</li> <li>Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements</li> </ul> <h3>As an ideal candidate, you will have</h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications</li> <li>Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics</li> <li>Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions</li> <li>Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout</li> <li>Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments</li> <li>Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly</li> <li>Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region</li> </ul> <h3>As an ideal candidate, you may also have</h3> <ul> <li>Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role</li> <li>Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews</li> <li>Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries</li> <li>Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio</li> </ul> <h3>What you will learn</h3> <ul> <li>Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills</li> <li>Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions</li> </ul> <h3>About MongoDB</h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.</p> <p>With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.</p> <p>Our compass at MongoDB is our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company">Leadership Commitment,</a> guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. </p> <p>To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb">From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy</a>, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys.<a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture"> Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB</a>, and help us make an impact on the world!</p> <p>MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</p> <p>MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.</p> <p><em>Req ID -3273528250</em></p>

jobs.title: Senior ML & AI Technical Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: <p>P-1377</p> <h4><strong>Mission</strong></h4> <p>As a Senior ML and AI Technical Solutions Engineer, you play a critical role by helping customers debug and maintain stable GenAI and ML Workloads with AI agent systems using the Databricks Platform.  You will develop product expertise end-to-end by advising a broad set of customers and use cases across the space - including products such as Agent Bricks, Vector Search and Model Serving.  You will collaborate cross-functionally with other teams - whether that’s working with engineering to improve the product or interacting directly with the account team on a specific customer issue.  TSEs have proven production troubleshooting and optimisation experience to help our customers’ workloads run smoothly and to achieve their strategic objectives with ML/AI technology with Databricks.  Additionally, you are an early adopter of GenAI technology to improve your own efficiency and amplify the team's output.  Reporting to a TSE manager - you will be part of a world class global support engineering organization for Databricks, known for your technical depth and delivering impeccable customer service.</p> <h4><strong>The Impact You Will Have</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Act as senior technical solution expert for complex issues spanning data pipelines, ML pipelines and/or AI applications, applying deep expertise in distributed systems. </li> <li>Analyse and troubleshoot production workloads at the code level, optimise for performance, reliability, latency, and cost.</li> <li>Diagnose and support Machine Learning and/or Large Language Model deployments, including real-time and batch inference, autoscaling, monitoring, logging, and alerting. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert guiding customers on experiment tracking, model registry, versioning, evaluation, labelling, tracing, and lifecycle observability.</li> <li>Provide high-quality support by guiding customers in leveraging Databricks AI to solve generative AI use cases & challenges, leveraging LLMs, MCP, AI Agents, RAG/Agentic RAG, APIs, vector embeddings, semantic search, Vector Search/Lakebase databases, context orchestration, memory management, and prompt engineering.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams to influence roadmap, product improvements and support business growth.</li> <li>Develop expertise in productionizing systems in Databricks and share your knowledge by contributing to wikis and other technical documentation, or by teaching our AI systems new skills, which will be used internally and externally by customers and partners.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Look For</strong></p> <p>8+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling Data, Machine Learning, and AI systems on-premises and in the cloud using Python, Scala, and Java in production environments, with expertise in Machine Learning and/or generative AI. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP); familiarity with Databricks is a plus. Proficient in data engineering necessary for orchestrating end-to-end machine learning training pipelines, ideally with experience processing large datasets with Apache Spark.</p> <ul> <li>SME knowledge in feature engineering, ML frameworks, model training, model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining strategies. This is mandatory; applications without this disclosure will not be considered. What we’re looking for 3+ years of experience as a full-stack or frontend-heavy engineer. Strong proficiency in React , Next.js , TypeScript/JavaScript. Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads. Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management). Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team. Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively. Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools. Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process) Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare: Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n. Stack Next.js (App Router) Clerk for authentication Convex for data + backend logic n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation TypeScript Requirements Public page The fictional company name is LendLoop . Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.” Show: A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex. A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk. Authenticated experience Only signed-in users can: List a tool with: name category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.) condition short description Request to borrow a tool for a date range. Approve or decline requests on their own tools. Mark a loan as returned. Show: All tools with availability status, filterable by category. “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views. Nice, minimal layout. Roles & rules Have two roles: admin : Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”. user : Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing. Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI. Automation with n8n Build at least two n8n workflows: Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs. Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Framework Integrations
jobs.description: <p>AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience (ABX) org, we're standing up a brand new engineering team in Gurugram to make that happen, and we're looking for Senior Software Engineers to be among its founding members.</p> <p>The team owns the connective layer between MongoDB and third-party AI frameworks, platforms, and tools — the integrations that let developers use MongoDB effectively with the AI stack they've already chosen. That means shipping into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech, working mostly in Python and TypeScript, and partnering with the Database Experience (DBX) org when an integration needs new driver, platform, or product capability underneath it.</p> <p>This is a self-sufficient team by design. You and your engineering manager will be based in Gurugram, and the group is set up to own its area end to end: to decide how integrations get built, tested, released, and maintained, without waiting on another time zone to unblock the day-to-day. You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, while collaborating with product, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers as the work requires.</p> <p>You'll integrate with fast-moving, often unproven technologies, make pragmatic calls in the face of ambiguity, and own high-visibility projects with minimal guidance. Priorities can shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, and partner needs, so we're looking for product-minded engineers who thrive on autonomy and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and representing MongoDB in developer communities.</p> <p>MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day — we value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.</p> <p>We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.</p> <h2>Position expectations</h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra, owning them from first exploratory spike through production release and ongoing maintenance.</li> <li>Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to completion independently, making sound decisions as requirements, frameworks, and customer needs evolve.</li> <li>Do the initial, exploratory work: assess a new framework, define the smallest useful version of an integration, get it in front of users quickly, and make a clear recommendation about whether and how to invest further.</li> <li>Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy while working through external maintainer review cycles.</li> <li>Build and maintain the team's engineering practices for a broad integration portfolio, including CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility awareness, and release readiness.</li> <li>Own the operational health of the integrations you build — monitoring, upgrades, breaking-change response, issue triage, and follow-through after launch.</li> <li>Partner with the Database Experience (DBX) org to define the driver, platform, and product capabilities your integrations depend on, making the case for what's needed and why.</li> <li>Work with product management, product design, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers to define the first version and future evolution of these integrations.</li> <li>Raise the technical bar within the team: shape architecture and development practices, give thorough code reviews, share what you know, and mentor peers and less experienced engineers.</li> <li>Stay current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems and bring what you learn back to the team's roadmap.</li> <li>Bring a research and discovery mindset: notice emerging opportunities in the ecosystem, surface them early, and make the case for where MongoDB should show up next.</li> <li>Flag issues, risks, and resource needs early and clearly, both within the team and to cross-functional partners in other regions.</li> </ul> <h2>Qualifications</h2> <ul> <li>Strong background in building core components for scalable, high-availability services, developer platforms, or libraries</li> <li>7+ years of experience building backend systems or developer-facing libraries, with strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript</li> <li>Proven success in designing, writing, testing, debugging, and performance tuning software in large, long-lived code bases, including code that other developers depend on</li> <li>Track record of identifying problems, implementing solutions, and delivering complex projects independently with minimal guidance</li> <li>A product-minded approach to engineering, with the judgment to make pragmatic tradeoffs between fast time-to-market and long-term maintainability, and the comfort to operate amid ambiguity and rapidly evolving technologies</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to context switch across a portfolio of projects while maintaining sound prioritization and quality.</li> <li>Strong and demonstrated interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape: AI frameworks, agentic patterns, RAG and retrieval, embedding, vector search, or adjacent areas.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills, including the ability to write things down clearly for partners you won't always overlap with in real time.</li> <li>Enjoys collaboration and being part of a close-knit team; is approachable, curious, and intellectually honest.</li> <li>Eager to learn, with a strong technical background.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to Have</h2> <ul> <li>Meaningful open source contributions, especially work that landed in repositories you don't own and required navigating external maintainer review</li> <li>Professional experience building AI or framework integrations, MCP servers, agent skills, or plugins for agentic applications</li> <li>Familiarity with the agentic AI tooling ecosystem (AI IDEs, CLIs, and assistants) and how developers integrate with it</li> <li>Experience building and operating CI/CD and automated testing infrastructure for libraries with many downstream version and platform combinations</li> <li>Experience working with databases and knowledge of database internals; query optimization experience, especially with MongoDB</li> <li>Experience with vector search, embedding pipelines, or index management</li> <li>Working knowledge of Java, Go, C#, or Rust</li> <li>Experience with containerization and orchestration platforms (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) and with AI frameworks and tooling</li> <li>Experience instrumenting usage telemetry and using it to guide investment decisions</li> <li>Familiarity with Jira and related tool</li> </ul> <h2>Success measures</h2> <ul> <li>In the first month, you will understand the team's scope, the high-level architecture of our integrations, where the relevant repositories and pipelines live, and the key technical dependencies around your work. You'll know who to go to in DBX and product, and you'll have landed your first meaningful code contribution</li> <li>In three months, you will own a significant integration or workstream end to end, have landed upstream contributions and established working relationships with the relevant external maintainers, and be contributing to how the team tests and releases its work</li> <li>In six months, you will have delivered a new integration or major capability that customers are using, improved the health and maintainability of the portfolio you own, and be a trusted voice in deciding where the team invests next</li> <li>In twelve months, you will be the recognized technical owner of a meaningful area of the portfolio, will have shaped architectural decisions and engineering practices beyond your own projects, and will be actively influencing the forward-looking technical strategy for how MongoDB shows up in the AI framework ecosystem</li> </ul> <h3>About MongoDB</h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.</p> <p>With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.</p> <p>Our compass at MongoDB is our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company">Leadership Commitment,</a> guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. </p> <p>To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb">From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy</a>, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys.<a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture"> Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB</a>, and help us make an impact on the world!</p> <p>MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.</p> <p>MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.</p> <p><em>Req ID- 3273512145</em></p>

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.</p> <p>Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!</p> <p>Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills</p> <h3><strong>What You Bring</strong></h3> <p><strong>Essential Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <strong>observability projects</strong> at both the architectural and program level.</li> <li>Experience working with monitoring tools that integrate into service management.</li> <li>Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.</li> <li><strong>Cloud & Infrastructure:</strong> Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.</li> <li><strong>Programming/Scripting:</strong> Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.</li> <li><strong>Travel:</strong> Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success<strong> (up to 20%) </strong></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.</li> <li>Additional Elastic Certifications</li> <li>Comfortable with Ansible, JavaScript, Terraform</li> <li>Experience working closely with a pre-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).</li> <li>Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.</li> <li>Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-DS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">What you’ll bring</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience building and maintaining backend systems We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software.
